OPERATOR HANDBOOK
×
MOVE WITH PURPOSE.

Extraction uploads only while standing inside the marked uplink deck. Outside pauses briefly; reenter before decay.

Engineering has two single-use amber capacitor banks. Shoot the cabinet or isolator: a 1.1-second warning precedes a 6 m discharge. Move clear, use solid cover or phase protection. The spent cabinet remains cover. Enemy fire cannot trigger it.

Soul Shift protects briefly. Dash within 4.5 m of a charging enemy to cancel its shot and stagger it for 0.8 s. A blue emitter flash confirms the break. Dashing toward a charge stops early on a successful break so you can follow up. Sideways dodges retain full travel. It deals no damage; the 4.5 s cooldown still applies. Your shield regenerates when you avoid damage.

THREAT VISOR · Orange ! means a charging threat. Muted chevrons show recent fire or hits. A number counts nearby sources in that direction; one source has no number. Offscreen cues use broad direction sectors, not exact positions. Optic brackets stay beside visible emitters. The lower readout follows one target near aim. Cues require clear optic sight and expire.

UNDERSTOOD
↗

beforePause.dialog:
EYES ONLY // VESPER
×
BRING THEM HOME.

The Drowned Relay was built to preserve human memories. Last night, it began broadcasting them as a distress call.

BREACH THE STATION

Use the central yard and its side lanes. Press M for paused facility planning. M or Close resumes; Escape opens the pause menu. Concrete cover breaks a sentinel's line of sight.

RECOVER THREE CORES

Follow each cyan beacon to its attached waist-high memory console. Step inside the floor ring and hold E for 0.9 seconds. Stay nearby while the memory is recovered. Each recovery escalates the defense response.

RETURN TO EXTRACTION

Bring all three memories back along either lit return aisle. Upload advances only while standing inside the marked uplink deck at the green beacon. Outside pauses briefly; reenter before decay. Face the yard, use the split baffles and watch open flanks.

Red means danger. Cyan means life. Soul Shift is your way through.

ACCEPT BRIEFING
↗

beforePause.dialog:
RESTORED RECORDS
×
THE VOICES WE CARRY.
MARA SOLBERG
STATION MEDIC

“If someone finds this… the children made the last ferry. Tell them I kept the light on.”

ELIAN VALE
RELAY ENGINEER

“I could erase the station. I could not erase the people inside it. Bring them home.”

SERA NORD
NIGHT OPERATOR

“Every signal is a person. If you can hear me, we are still here.”

RETURN
